natural: Lost on the road, but knowing to turn back

meaning.en: To realise one's mistakes and mend one's ways.
meaning.zh: 迷了路知道回来。比喻犯了错误能改正。

equivalents: see the error of one's ways
turn back before it's too late

examples.zh: 希望他能迷途知返，重新做人。
examples.en: I hope he'll see the error of his ways and start afresh.

examples.zh: 他迷途知返，戒掉了赌瘾。
examples.en: He turned back in time and kicked his gambling habit.

natural: One call and a hundred respond

meaning.en: To command a wide following; everyone responds to one's call.
meaning.zh: 一人呼唤，百人响应。形容号召力强。

examples.zh: 他在村里很有威望，一呼百应。
examples.en: He's so respected in the village that everyone answers his call.

examples.zh: 公益活动一发起，网友一呼百应。
examples.en: As soon as the charity drive launched, netizens responded en masse.

usage.en: Predicate. In speech 一 is yì.

natural: Retreating three days' march

meaning.en: To give way to avoid conflict; to steer clear of someone.
meaning.zh: 比喻退让和回避，避免冲突。

examples.zh: 他脾气暴躁，同事们都对他退避三舍。
examples.en: He's so hot-tempered that colleagues give him a wide berth.

examples.zh: 面对这样的强敌，对手只能退避三舍。
examples.en: Faced with such a strong opponent, rivals could only back off.

story.en: The exiled Prince Chong'er promised the King of Chu that if their armies ever met, Jin would retreat three days' march (三舍, 90 li). As Duke Wen of Jin, he kept his word at the Battle of Chengpu — then won.
story.zh: 重耳流亡楚国时许诺，若晋楚交战，晋军"退避三舍"。后城濮之战中他履行诺言，退兵九十里后大败楚军。

usage.en: Predicate. 舍 is shè (a day's march, 30 li).
usage.zh: 多作谓语。"舍"读 shè，古代行军三十里为一舍。

natural: Following good advice as water flows downhill

meaning.en: To accept good advice readily.
meaning.zh: 形容乐于接受别人的正确意见。

examples.zh: 好领导应该从善如流。
examples.en: A good leader should be open to advice.

examples.zh: 他从善如流，立刻修改了方案。
examples.en: He took the advice on board and immediately revised the plan.

story.en: When the Jin general Luan Shu followed his subordinates' sound advice, the chronicle commented: "Following good advice as water flows — how fitting!" (从善如流，宜哉).

natural: Sleeping on brushwood and tasting gall

meaning.en: To endure hardship to prepare for revenge or a comeback.
meaning.zh: 睡在柴草上，尝苦胆。形容人刻苦自励，发愤图强。

examples.zh: 他卧薪尝胆十年，终于东山再起。
examples.en: After ten years of steeling himself, he finally made a comeback.

examples.zh: 球队输球后卧薪尝胆，第二年夺冠。
examples.en: After defeat the team endured gruelling training and won the title the next year.

story.en: King Goujian of Yue, defeated and humiliated by Wu, kept a gall bladder to taste before meals to remember his shame (later tellings add that he slept on brushwood). After twenty years he destroyed Wu.
story.zh: 越王勾践被吴国打败后，"置胆于坐，坐卧即仰胆，饮食亦尝胆"，后人又加"卧薪"之说。二十年后灭吴。

natural: Mechanically copying and forcing it to fit

meaning.en: To copy mechanically without regard to circumstances.
meaning.zh: 指不顾实际情况，机械地搬用别人的经验、方法。

equivalents: a square peg in a round hole

examples.zh: 国外的经验不能生搬硬套。
examples.en: Foreign experience can't be copied blindly.

examples.zh: 写作文生搬硬套名言，效果不好。
examples.en: Forcing famous quotations into an essay doesn't work well.

natural: Stepping straight up into the blue clouds

meaning.en: To rise rapidly to high position; a meteoric rise.
meaning.zh: 比喻一下子达到很高的地位。

examples.zh: 他靠一部电影平步青云，成了大明星。
examples.en: One film brought him a meteoric rise to stardom.

examples.zh: 没有人能平步青云，成功需要积累。
examples.en: No one shoots to the top overnight — success takes time.

natural: Truly alarmed and truly afraid

meaning.en: With fear and trepidation; deeply anxious (often over-deferential).
meaning.zh: 原是古代臣子给皇帝上奏章时用的套语。后形容尊敬而又惶恐不安。

examples.zh: 第一次见董事长，他诚惶诚恐。
examples.en: Meeting the chairman for the first time, he was full of trepidation.

examples.zh: 得到这么高的评价，我诚惶诚恐。
examples.en: I'm humbled and a little daunted by such high praise.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial. Originally the formula opening officials' memorials to the emperor.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语。原为臣子上奏的套语。

natural: Strange forms and odd shapes

meaning.en: Weird and grotesque shapes.
meaning.zh: 奇奇怪怪的形状。

examples.zh: 溶洞里有许多奇形怪状的石头。
examples.en: The cave is full of weird and wonderful rock formations.

examples.zh: 海底生活着各种奇形怪状的鱼。
examples.en: All kinds of bizarre-looking fish live on the seabed.

usage.en: Attributive. Very common in school descriptions.

natural: The people have nothing to live on

meaning.en: The people cannot make a living; widespread misery.
meaning.zh: 老百姓无法生活下去。

examples.zh: 战乱连年，民不聊生。
examples.en: With war year after year, the people lived in misery.

examples.zh: 苛捐杂税逼得民不聊生。
examples.en: Crippling taxes drove the people into destitution.

story.en: The rebels against Qin described its rule: "The people were exhausted... and had nothing to live on" (百姓罢敝……民不聊生).

natural: I alone am supreme

meaning.en: Arrogantly self-important; thinking oneself above all.
meaning.zh: 原为推崇佛的至高无上。后形容极端自高自大。

examples.zh: 他当了经理后唯我独尊，听不进别人的意见。
examples.en: Since becoming manager he's been so full of himself that he won't listen to anyone.

examples.zh: 大公司不能唯我独尊，要尊重合作伙伴。
examples.en: Big companies shouldn't lord it over their partners.

story.en: Buddhist legend says the newborn Buddha took seven steps, pointed to heaven and earth, and declared: "Above heaven and below heaven, I alone am honoured" (天上天下，唯我独尊).
story.zh: 佛经载释迦牟尼出生时一手指天，一手指地，说："天上天下，唯我独尊。"

natural: Grass growing and orioles flying

meaning.en: A lush spring scene of growing grass and flying birds.
meaning.zh: 形容江南暮春的景色。

examples.zh: 三月的江南草长莺飞，美不胜收。
examples.en: Southern China in March is a lush spring scene of breathtaking beauty.

examples.zh: 草长莺飞的季节，正适合踏青。
examples.en: Late spring is the perfect time for an outing.

origin.source: 南朝梁·丘迟《与陈伯之书》

story.en: Qiu Chi wrote to a general who had defected, evoking his homeland: "In the third month of late spring, the grass grows long in Jiangnan, flowers cover the trees and orioles fly in flocks".
story.zh: 丘迟《与陈伯之书》："暮春三月，江南草长，杂花生树，群莺乱飞。"

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. 长 is zhǎng.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。"长"读 zhǎng。

natural: Ten thousand purples and a thousand reds

meaning.en: A riot of colour; flourishing variety.
meaning.zh: 形容百花齐放，色彩艳丽。也比喻事物丰富多彩。

examples.zh: 春天的花园万紫千红。
examples.en: The garden in spring is a riot of colour.

examples.zh: 文艺舞台呈现出万紫千红的景象。
examples.en: The arts scene is flourishing with variety.

story.en: Zhu Xi's poem: "Easily I recognise the face of the east wind — ten thousand purples and a thousand reds, all of it is spring" (万紫千红总是春).
story.zh: 朱熹《春日》："等闲识得东风面，万紫千红总是春。"

natural: Working when the sun rises

meaning.en: To work from sunrise (and rest at sunset); a simple rural life.
meaning.zh: 太阳出来就劳作。形容简朴的田园生活。

examples.zh: 农民们日出而作，日落而息。
examples.en: The farmers work from sunrise and rest at sunset.

examples.zh: 他厌倦了城市，向往日出而作的田园生活。
examples.en: Tired of the city, he longs for a simple rural life.

story.en: An ancient folk song sung in the age of Emperor Yao: "At sunrise I work, at sunset I rest; I dig a well to drink, till the fields to eat — what has the emperor's power to do with me?"
story.zh: 《击壤歌》："日出而作，日入而息。凿井而饮，耕田而食。帝力于我何有哉！"

usage.en: Usually in the pair 日出而作，日落（入）而息.
usage.zh: 常说"日出而作，日落而息"。

natural: Singing loudly and advancing boldly

meaning.en: To advance triumphantly and rapidly.
meaning.zh: 高声歌唱，勇猛前进。形容在前进道路上情绪高涨，步伐迅猛。

examples.zh: 这支球队一路高歌猛进，杀入决赛。
examples.en: The team swept triumphantly into the final.

examples.zh: 新能源汽车销量高歌猛进。
examples.en: New-energy vehicle sales are going from strength to strength.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial. Common in news.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语，新闻常用。

natural: The heart's flowers bursting into bloom

meaning.en: Overjoyed; elated.
meaning.zh: 心里高兴得像花儿盛开一样。形容极其高兴。

examples.zh: 听到录取的消息，她心花怒放。
examples.en: Hearing she'd been accepted, she was over the moon.

examples.zh: 收到这么多祝福，他心花怒放。
examples.en: Getting so many good wishes, he was on cloud nine.

natural: Taking by trickery and seizing by force

meaning.en: To obtain by trickery or force.
meaning.zh: 用欺诈的手段骗取，或用强力夺取财物。

examples.zh: 地主巧取豪夺，霸占了农民的土地。
examples.en: The landlord swindled and seized the peasants' land.

examples.zh: 这些财产都是他巧取豪夺来的。
examples.en: He got all this property by hook or by crook.

natural: A mouth like a waterfall

meaning.en: Eloquent; talking in a torrent.
meaning.zh: 讲起话来像瀑布倾泻不停。形容能言善辩。

examples.zh: 他口若悬河，一讲就是两个小时。
examples.en: He has the gift of the gab and can talk for two hours straight.

examples.zh: 推销员口若悬河，我差点就买了。
examples.en: The silver-tongued salesman nearly had me buying.

origin.source: 南朝宋·刘义庆《世说新语·赏誉》

story.en: Wang Yan praised the philosopher Guo Xiang: "Listening to Xiang speak is like a hanging river pouring down — it flows without end."
story.zh: 王衍说："听象语，如悬河泻水，注而不竭。"

usage.en: Predicate. Can praise eloquence or hint at glibness.

natural: Using surprise to win

meaning.en: To win by surprise or an unexpected move.
meaning.zh: 用奇兵或奇计战胜敌人。比喻用对方意料不到的方法取胜。

examples.zh: 小公司要出奇制胜，不能跟大公司硬拼。
examples.en: Small firms must win with surprise — they can't fight big firms head-on.

examples.zh: 教练换上一名新人，出奇制胜。
examples.en: The coach brought on a newcomer and won with the surprise move.

story.en: Sunzi: "In battle, engage with the orthodox and win with the unexpected" (凡战者，以正合，以奇胜).
story.zh: 《孙子·势》："凡战者，以正合，以奇胜。"

natural: As easy as turning over one's hand

meaning.en: As easy as pie.
meaning.zh: 像翻一下手掌那样容易。比喻事情非常容易办到。

examples.zh: 对他来说，修电脑易如反掌。
examples.en: Fixing computers is a piece of cake for him.

examples.zh: 别以为创业易如反掌。
examples.en: Don't think starting a business is child's play.

story.en: Mencius said that for Qi to unite the realm through benevolent rule "would be as easy as turning over one's hand" (由反手也).

natural: Looking to the leader's horse's head

meaning.en: To follow someone's lead unquestioningly.
meaning.zh: 看着主将的马头决定进退。比喻服从指挥或乐于追随。

examples.zh: 公司上下唯老板马首是瞻。
examples.en: Everyone in the company takes their cue from the boss.

examples.zh: 小国不必唯大国马首是瞻。
examples.en: Small countries needn't follow the big powers blindly.

story.en: The Jin commander Xun Yan ordered: "At cockcrow, harness the chariots... watch only my horse's head" (唯余马首是瞻).
story.zh: 荀偃下令："鸡鸣而驾，塞井夷灶，唯余马首是瞻。"

usage.en: Usually 唯……马首是瞻. 瞻 is zhān.

natural: Clinging to the broken and incomplete

meaning.en: To cling to outdated things; ultra-conservative.
meaning.zh: 守着残缺陈旧的东西不放。形容思想保守，不求改进。

examples.zh: 企业抱残守缺，只会被市场淘汰。
examples.en: A company that clings to the past will be left behind by the market.

examples.zh: 传承文化不等于抱残守缺。
examples.en: Preserving culture doesn't mean clinging to everything old.

natural: Lost for ten thousand aeons

meaning.en: Lost forever; beyond redemption.
meaning.zh: 佛教指永远不能恢复人身。后指永远不能恢复。

examples.zh: 一旦沾上毒品，就可能万劫不复。
examples.en: Once you get into drugs, you may be lost forever.

examples.zh: 这个错误让公司陷入万劫不复的境地。
examples.en: This mistake plunged the company past the point of no return.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. 劫 = a Buddhist aeon (kalpa).
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。"劫"为佛教时间单位。

natural: Offending heaven and violating reason

meaning.en: Utterly immoral; a crime against heaven and humanity.
meaning.zh: 做事残忍，违背天理。

examples.zh: 拐卖儿童是伤天害理的罪行。
examples.en: Child trafficking is a heinous crime.

examples.zh: 他干了很多伤天害理的事。
examples.en: He did many unconscionable things.

natural: Putting justice above family

meaning.en: To put justice above family loyalty; to turn in a guilty relative.
meaning.zh: 为了维护正义，对犯罪的亲属不徇私情，使其受到应有的惩罚。

equivalents: no one is above the law

examples.zh: 他大义灭亲，举报了犯罪的弟弟。
examples.en: Putting justice before family, he reported his brother's crime.

examples.zh: 大义灭亲需要很大的勇气。
examples.en: It takes great courage to turn in one's own family.

story.en: Shi Que of Wey arranged the execution of his own son Shi Hou, who had helped murder the ruler. The chronicle praised him: "Great righteousness destroys kinship" (大义灭亲).
story.zh: 卫国大夫石碏的儿子石厚参与弑君，石碏设计让陈国杀了石厚。《左传》称"大义灭亲"。
